# Cloud Observability & Telemetry Platform

Modern cloud-native telemetry for microservices and distributed systems. Real-time distributed tracing, automated latency bottleneck detection, and cost intelligence dashboard.

## Core Capabilities
Instant trace analysis, metrics aggregation, and intelligent anomaly alerting across AWS, GCP, and Azure.

## Deployment & Pricing
Get started in minutes with our Helm chart or Docker container. Starter tier begins at $49/month with enterprise custom SLA plans.
